نصطلح (form VIII)
# نَصْطَلِحُ (naṣṭaliḥu) /nasˤ.tˤa.li.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# نُصْطَلَحُ (nuṣṭalaḥu) /nusˤ.tˤa.la.ħu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# نَصْطَلِحَ (naṣṭaliḥa) /nasˤ.tˤa.li.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# نُصْطَلَحَ (nuṣṭalaḥa) /nusˤ.tˤa.
